title: Orange cat flops over for belly rubs instead of moving out of the way
description:
Elizabeth shared this clip of her orange fluffball, who knows exactly how to get what he wants.

''My fat cat was in my way and kept begging for more snacks, so I went to gently nudge him out of the way with my foot,'' she told WooGlobe.

''He took it as an opportunity to flop over and ask for belly rubs instead.''

Elizabeth could say no to those soft rolls and pleading eyes.

The snacks could wait, but belly rubs were clearly non-negotiable.
